hero.subtitle: The ultimate tactical advantage for the modern hooper. Find courts near you, log every play session without lifting a finger, and climb a real leaderboard.

items.title: FIND YOUR COURT
items.body: A map of the courts in your area: hours, surface, lighting and which ones are open right now. Pick how to get there, on foot or by vehicle.

items.title: LOGS ITSELF
items.body: You arrive at the court and your play session starts on its own; you leave and it closes on its own. It works even with the app closed. You touch nothing.

items.title: YOUR GAME, YOUR NUMBERS
items.body: Log how many games you played, how many you won and in what format, from 1v1 to 5v5. The app gives you points per game, win rate and your best game.

stats.title: MASTER YOUR
stats.shotAlt: 1of1 profile: level, XP, games, streak and ranking.
stats.desc: Don't just play—analyze. Every session gets logged: how many games you played, how many you won and how many points you scored in each. With a watch connected, real effort is added: heart-rate zones, calories and distance.
list: Points per game, best game and win rate
Heart-rate effort zones and calories with a personal record
Ranking by week, month, season or all-time

cta.title: UNLEASH YOUR POTENTIAL
cta.subtitle: Find where to play, log every session and take your progress with you. The next court is waiting for you.

share.title: Share your results
share.body: When you close your session, the app builds a card ready for your stories: result, score and your numbers, made to read even as a thumbnail. Share it with your crew and dare them to beat it.

socialHub.title: SOCIAL HUB
socialHub.body: Add friends by their @handle and see who's playing and where, when they share their status with you. Chat with your crew and set up every pickup from the app.

pickups.title: PICKUPS & EVENTS
pickups.body: Set up a run at any court, invite your crew and sort it all out in the chat: teams, tip-off time and how many points you play to.
pickups.publicBody: Post your game and anyone can jump in straight from the map, no invite needed. Perfect when you're two players short and don't want to sit out.

clan.title: CONQUER THE COURT
clan.body: Put your clan's tag on and earn XP at your court. The clan with the most XP in the season claims the title of

discover.title: LEAVE YOUR MARK
discover.lead: We don't build the map — the people who go out looking do. Know a court that isn't listed? Add it, and it stays signed with your name for good, in plain sight of everyone who plays there after you.
discover.body: Every court you add is one more court where someone in your neighborhood gets to play tomorrow. Discoverers don't get erased: your signature stays as long as the court does.
discover.note: We review every court before publishing it to keep the map reliable. We'll let you know once it's approved.

seasons.title: TWO SEASONS A YEAR
seasons.lead: Competition is split into calendar halves. It's not a rolling window: they're fixed dates, the same for everyone, easy to remember.

why.title: Everyone starts over
why.body: Join today and you're not years behind the leader. Every January 1st and July 1st the table resets and you compete on level ground.

why.title: Titles go back on the line
why.body: King of the court and Court conquered by clan last one season. Nobody keeps the crown forever: you have to go out and defend it.

why.title: Six months is real time
why.body: Long enough that whoever actually played wins, not whoever had one good week — but short enough that a rematch is always around the corner.

seasons.shotAlt: A court detail in 1of1: rating and the clan that conquered it this season.
seasons.shotCaption: Every court shows which clan conquered it this season.
seasons.keepBody: A season resets the competition, not your history: your level, your achievements and your lifetime XP stay for good. You can view your numbers by week, month, season or all time.

wearables.title: PLAY WITH YOUR WATCH ON
wearables.lead: If you play wearing a smartwatch or a band that syncs with Health Connect, 1of1 reads the real effort of every session —heart rate, calories, steps and distance, plus blood oxygen or heart-rate variability if your watch measures them— and turns it into metrics you can't eyeball.
wearables.comboTitle: Your body and your game, together
wearables.comboBody: The watch tells you how hard you pushed; the points you log at the end tell you how it went on court. Both sit together in each session's detail: heart-rate zones, calories with a personal record and your points per game.
wearables.chartFoot: Both stay saved in every session.

terms.intro: By creating an account and using 1of1, you accept these terms.

sections.heading: Use of the app
sections.body: 1of1 helps you find courts and log your play sessions. You are responsible for the information you submit (courts, reviews, handle, name) and for playing safely: the app does not monitor or guarantee the condition of courts.

sections.heading: Content and conduct
sections.body: You are responsible for the content you post, including court reviews and messages sent in pickup chats. Offensive content, spam, harassment, or impersonation is not allowed. You can report inappropriate content or users from the app and block other users. We review reports and may remove content or suspend accounts that violate these rules. We do not tolerate abusive content.

sections.heading: Location and background
sections.body: Play-session detection uses your location, including in the background if you authorize it. You can disable it anytime from Settings → Privacy or from system permissions.

sections.heading: Health data

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: The app is provided "as is". We are not liable for injuries, losses, or damages arising from the use of the app or from attending courts.

sections.heading: Account deletion
sections.body: You can delete your account anytime from Settings → Delete Account.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic. Any dispute will be submitted to the ordinary courts of the City of Buenos Aires, without prejudice to any consumer-protection rights recognized by the law of your country of residence.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your 1of1 account and its associated data at any time, whether or not you have the app installed.

sections.heading: From the app (instant)
sections.body: Open 1of1 → Profile → Settings → Delete account. Confirm and your account is deleted right away, no waiting.

sections.heading: Without access to the app
sections.body: Email us at francobusch130@gmail.com from the same address you signed up with, subject "Delete my account". We process the request within 30 days and confirm by email once it's done.

sections.heading: What gets deleted
sections.body: Your profile (name, handle, photo, clan badge), your play-session history and stats, your court reviews, your friendships, the pickups you created and their chats, and the messages you sent. Health data (Health Connect) never left your phone, so there's nothing to delete on the server.

sections.heading: What may be kept briefly
sections.body: Database backups may retain the information for a short period before being fully purged, and some records may be kept if required by law (e.g. fraud prevention).

sections.heading: Google accounts
sections.body: If you signed up with Google, deleting your 1of1 account doesn't affect your Google account. You can review the permissions you granted to 1of1 from your Google Account settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: 1of1 ("the app") is an application to find basketball courts and log your play sessions. This policy explains what data we use and why.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: Account data: name, email, and optionally city and phone number you provide when signing up. Your birth date is stored to verify and confirm you meet the minimum age. Handle and profile data: public handle, clan badge, photo (if you sign in with Google), and your game stats. Location: we use it to show nearby courts and detect when you're playing; with "Always" permission, detection works with the app closed. We don't store your coordinates in our database, only which court you played at (see "Third-party services"). Health data (optional): if you connect Health (Health Connect), we read calories, heart rate, steps, distance, speed, blood oxygen, resting heart rate, heart rate variability and respiratory rate from your play sessions, plus the exercise sessions your watch records. We only read them (we never write to your health history) and they stay ONLY on your device: they are not uploaded to our servers. Game activity: play-session history (court, date, duration, result, score, format and the points you log), your past streaks, your favorite courts and the users you blocked. This is backed up on our server so you don't lose it if you reinstall the app or switch phones. Health metrics are NOT backed up: they stay only on your device. Messages: the content of pickup chats is stored on our server so we can show it to that pickup's participants.

sections.heading: What we use it for
sections.body: To make the app work: locating you on the map, detecting and scoring your play sessions, showing your profile and rankings, and connecting the community (friends, pickups, and their chats).

sections.heading: Where it's stored
sections.body: Account, game, and message data is stored on our own backend, hosted on Render (Render Services, Inc., servers in the United States) on a Supabase Postgres database (Supabase, Inc.). Both providers act as data processors on our behalf. By using the app you accept this international data transfer to the United States. Health data never leaves your phone.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: We use Google services for map features: Google Maps (displaying the map), Geocoding (converting addresses to coordinates), and Directions (calculating routes). When you use those features, your location and/or the address queried is sent to Google. Map-area and route lookups go through our server, which forwards them to Google and does not store the coordinates in our database. If you sign in with Google, your authentication and profile photo are provided by Google Sign-In. Google's handling of that data is governed by its own privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy).

sections.heading: Notifications
sections.body: The app shows local notifications on your device: a court-arrival alert, the play-session timer and, if you leave it on, a reminder to get back on court when several days pass without a session (at most three in a row, and only until you play again). They are generated on your phone: we do not send them from our servers or share data with third parties to show them. You can turn them off in your system permissions, and the come-back reminder in Settings → Privacy.

sections.heading: News
sections.body: The News section shows basketball stories (NBA, WNBA and Liga Nacional) that our server fetches from ESPN and NewsData.io. We send none of your data to those services: the request is by league only.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove it from our database; it may persist briefly in backups before being fully purged.

sections.heading: What other users see
sections.body: Other users can see your name, handle, badge, and public stats. In pickup chats, participants see the messages you send and your handle. Your "playing" presence, court, and time are only shared if you enable those settings in Settings → Privacy (all off by default).

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, correct, or delete your data. Settings → Delete Account removes your account and data from our database (you can also do this without the app: see "Delete Account"). Email francobusch130@gmail.com to exercise any right (Argentina's Law 25.326 and, depending on your jurisdiction, equivalent rights such as CCPA/CPRA in the US).

sections.heading: Minors
sections.body: The app is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you are a minor, use the app with your legal guardian's authorization.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy; we'll notify you within the app. If you have questions, email francobusch130@gmail.com.
